Great! You’re almost a VIP 😎

Your brigade will be *protected from deletion and get a stable connection*, while you’ll *receive a separate key with unlimited speed and traffic.*

Choose the VIP brigade that works best for you:

If you think this is a mistake, please contact support.

You’re almost an unlimited VIP 😎

To update your status correctly and securely, please answer one question:
*Do you have a free brigade?*

You have an active brigade - you're awesome! 😎

But to transfer all your keys and settings correctly, we need a way to identify your current brigade.

You have two options:

buttons.label: Log in through the Key Desk

stages.message:
Enter the brigadier’s name - an adjective followed by the laureate’s last name.
For example: “Веселый Эйнштейн” or “Потрясающая Кюри” ✍️

That doesn’t look like a brigadier’s name 🤔

Please try again and *enter an adjective followed by the laureate’s last name.*
For example: “Веселый Эйнштейн” or “Потрясающая Кюри”
Great! Now please enter the 6 magic words ✨

Open sesame didn't work - something's wrong with the name or the words.🙈 

Be careful - the name consists of *an adjective and a laureate's surname*, for example "Веселый Эйнштейн" or "Потрясающая Кюри". And the six words must be in *exactly the same order we gave them to you!*

If you don't remember the name and/or magic words - maybe it's time to start fresh. 😎

Sorry, you’ve already entered the name and 6 words incorrectly, so you’ll need to wait %d hours before trying again ⏳

Don’t want to wait? You can create *a new VIP brigade from scratch - it will be yours right away, with no waiting or limits* :)

Great, we’ll upgrade your brigade through the Key desk 🙌

Log in (https://vpn.works/) with *your brigadier key* and click the “VIP Brigade” banner in the top-right corner - where Sasha Bely is. We’ll take care of the rest :)
